content: ESLint rule deprecation: meta.deprecated (boolean or DeprecatedInfo object) + meta.replacedBy array of {rule:{name,url}} entries recorded on the rule definition itself, surfaced as a lint warning when a deprecated rule is configured. Rule IDs are never silently reused; ambiguity exists in ecosystem (unclear if replacement is same-plugin) which was a recognized pain point requiring a schema revision (2024) to add explicit plugin+rule qualification. Precedent supports mediadiff's alias+deprecation-only-no-silent-rename rule, and warns that the alias metadata needs an explicit source-plugin/family qualifier from day one to avoid ESLint's ambiguity problem.
